ny-new-york-2026-civil-court-frants-vlad.name: Vlad Frants
ny-new-york-2026-civil-court-frants-vlad.bio: Serves in an adjudicatory role within New York City; former government litigator with the IRS Office of Chief Counsel and former private-practice attorney.

ny-queens-2026-civil-court-wong-edmond.name: Edmond Wong
ny-queens-2026-civil-court-wong-edmond.bio: Court Attorney-Referee in Queens County Surrogate's Court; former Associate Court Attorney in Queens County Civil Court.

ny-queens-2026-civil-court-milner-julie.name: Julie M. Milner
ny-queens-2026-civil-court-milner-julie.bio: Attorney and educator with a background in civil rights advocacy and educational leadership, including work as a high school teacher.

ny-queens-2026-civil-court-valle-bueno-j.name: Jasmine I. Valle-Bueno
ny-queens-2026-civil-court-valle-bueno-j.bio: Practicing attorney with over a decade of experience in criminal, civil, family, and housing law.

ny-richmond-2026-supreme-court-pinto-mic.name: Michael J. Pinto
ny-richmond-2026-supreme-court-pinto-mic.bio: Judge of the Richmond County Civil Court and former attorney.

ny-richmond-2026-civil-court-golden-tash.name: Tashanna Golden
ny-richmond-2026-civil-court-golden-tash.bio: Housing Court Judge since 2022; former Director of the Housing Unit at Staten Island Legal Services.

ny-richmond-2026-civil-court-yost-glenn.name: Glenn A. Yost
ny-richmond-2026-civil-court-yost-glenn.bio: Staten Island attorney and educator; retired New York City Police Department officer with a 20-year career.

il-cook-2026-circuit-burke-mckenzie-stev.name: Steven Q. McKenzie
il-cook-2026-circuit-burke-mckenzie-stev.bio: Public-interest attorney with decades of experience.

il-cook-2026-circuit-coghlan-rice-ashont.name: Ashonta C. Rice
il-cook-2026-circuit-coghlan-rice-ashont.bio: Attorney and founding partner of a family law and estate planning practice, with twenty years of practice in domestic relations and child protection.

il-cook-2026-circuit-hooks-stewart-ava.name: Ava George Stewart
il-cook-2026-circuit-hooks-stewart-ava.bio: Private practice attorney, former prosecutor, and law professor at UIC.

il-cook-2026-circuit-karkula-thedford-d-.name: D'Anthony "Tony" Thedford
il-cook-2026-circuit-karkula-thedford-d-.bio: Circuit Court of Cook County judge appointed in December 2024; former trial lawyer and founding partner of Thedford Garber Law, LLC.

oh-cuyahoga-2026-app8-0209-crossman-jeff.name: Jeffrey A. Crossman
oh-cuyahoga-2026-app8-0209-crossman-jeff.bio: Ohio trial and appellate lawyer; former Parma City Council member and two-term member of the Ohio House of Representatives.
